_meta.description: Full list of requirements taken from the project brief, one row each, with the delivery status of this site and the official source that governs or evidences that status. Nothing is inferred: a requirement is marked Delivered only where the site actually does it, and Not built / Unverifiable otherwise, with the official rule or missing access named in the blocker column.

status_meanings.Delivered: Working on the published site now.
status_meanings.Delivered (partial): Something is published, but a named part of the requirement is missing or unverified.
status_meanings.Not built - blocked (policy): Building it as described would breach a rule that is cited in the Blocker / official rule column. Not attempted.
status_meanings.Not built - needs access: Not blocked by policy, but needs an Associates account, an API key or reporting data this repository does not have.
status_meanings.Unverifiable (blank + flagged): No official source provides the value. The field is left blank on the site and flagged for review.

requirements.requirement: Build an AI-powered Amazon affiliate marketing platform.
requirements.blocker: Two official rules gate it. Associates Program Policies, Participation Requirements Section 5: 'You will not, without our express prior written approval, use, or allow any third party to use, any Special Links or Program Content to develop machine learning models or related technology.' Amazon Conditions of Use, 'License and Access': 'You will not, and will not allow any third party to, use AI-generated content from the Amazon Services to, directly or indirectly, develop or improve large language or multimodal models, machine learning models or related technology.'

Conditions of Use, 'License and Access', excludes 'any collection and use of any product listings, descriptions, or prices' and 'any use of data mining, robots, or similar data gathering and extraction tools'. Participation Requirements Section 6(s) bars artificially generating clicks or impressions 'whether by way of a robot or software program or otherwise'. The three records on this site were read by hand from official pages, not by an automated collector.

Amazon shows popularity badges and 'bought in past month' signals on its own pages. Reuse of Amazon-displayed sales and review metrics is restricted by Participation Requirements Section 6(t), and no official source publishes trend data for these ASINs. The Trend column is blank on every product row.

Conversion and earnings data exists only inside Associates reports, which need an enrolled account. No Associates account, reporting feed or tag is available here (F-03), so no conversion value is published.

Participation Requirements Section 2(b): a site 'may only show prices and availability if: (a) we serve the link in which that price and availability data are displayed, or (b) you obtain Product pricing and availability data via Creators API or PA API'. Section 6(y): 'your Site must not have price tracking and/or price alerting functionality.' The verifier (scripts/verify.py) fails the build if any page contains a currency amount.

Participation Requirements Section 6(t): 'You will not display or otherwise use any of our customer reviews or star ratings, in part or in whole, on your Site unless you have obtained a link to that customer review or star rating through Creators API or PA API.' No review text, star rating or review count is published.

requirements.delivered: Each product row lists the three also-viewed ASINs read from its Amazon product page, with a direct link to each competitor listing.
requirements.blocker: The 'Customers who viewed this item also viewed' module is an advertising slot. On the 2026-11-14 snapshot the 'Sponsored' label sat directly above that module on P1 and P3, and a sponsored brand-store module sat above it on P2. The lists are therefore ad-influenced, not organic competition data, and no ranking or share is derived from them.

requirements.delivered: The formula is documented with its source: Commission Income Statement Section 3, 'Commission Income is calculated as a percentage of Qualifying Revenue', and Section 1 defines Qualifying Revenue.
requirements.blocker: The rate itself is in the Appendix, reached from https://affiliate-program.amazon.com/help/operating/schedule, which redirects to an Amazon sign-in. No rate is entered, so no earnings figure is calculated. Third-party commission tables conflict and are not used.

Same gate as REQ-01: Participation Requirements Section 5 (no Special Links or Program Content to develop machine learning models without express prior written approval) and Conditions of Use 'License and Access' (no Amazon AI-generated content for model development). No article has been generated from Amazon-derived data.

A comparison table needs price or rating columns, which are withheld under Sections 2(b) and 6(t). Section 2(b) also requires that any 'comparison' format display both the lowest new and lowest used Amazon price. Without a Creators API or PA API feed the comparison cannot be built compliantly.

Same gate as REQ-09. Participation Requirements Section 6(a) also bars altering Program Content, and Section 3(c) makes the Associate responsible for the accuracy of every product description posted on the site.

requirements.delivered: Findings A-01 to A-04 state the niche actually evidenced: all three products share one Amazon category path (Home & Kitchen > Kitchen & Dining > Small Appliances > Fryers > Air Fryers), two share a brand, and the set spans three formats.
requirements.blocker: 'Profitable' cannot be evidenced: the commission rate is unverified (F-01) and prices are withheld (F-02), so no profitability claim is made. The sample is three products, not a market scan.

No ad copy, email, social or landing-page copy has been generated. Any such content would be built on the withheld price, rating and commission data (F-01, F-02) and would need the REQ-01 compliance review first.

requirements.delivered: All three supplied links are published on the dashboard, the all-products table and each category page, each with the Associates disclosure directly beside it.
requirements.blocker: Attribution is unverified. The resolved URLs carry tracking parameters (lv, channelId, plpRedirect) but no 'tag=' parameter, and Participation Requirements Section 2(b) requires the Associates ID 'as a parameter in the URL of each link'. Whether these links were generated under the user's Associates ID cannot be confirmed from outside the account.

Click and conversion reporting is produced by Amazon, not by this site: Commission Income Statement Section 6, 'We will use commercially reasonable efforts to accurately and comprehensively track Qualifying Purchases ... and creating and distributing to you our reports'. No Associates account or reporting feed is connected, and Sections 2(b) and 6(z) restrict attaching non-Amazon analytics to Special Links. No click, conversion or revenue figure is published.

requirements.requirement: Continuously optimize campaigns to maximize affiliate revenue.
requirements.blocker: Optimization loops need the click and conversion data of REQ-15 and the commission rate of REQ-08. Neither is available, and Participation Requirements Section 6(q) bars attempting to artificially increase commission income.

requirements.delivered: The parts that can be automated safely are automated: scripts/build_site.py regenerates every page from data/, and scripts/verify.py re-checks the data, links, anchors, per-row source links, disclosure and the price and rating guards. The Site checks workflow runs both on every push and pull request and fails if the committed docs/ differs from the build.
requirements.blocker: Automating the research, content and campaign layers is gated by REQ-01, REQ-02 and REQ-15. Section 6(s) specifically bars robot-generated clicks or impressions.

requirements.delivered: The site is generated from five JSON files in data/. Adding a product means adding one record; pages, category pages, the verification log and the flag pages rebuild from it with no manual page editing. No per-page hand maintenance is needed.
Every published value carries the official page it was read from. Values with no official source are left blank and flagged rather than estimated, so no decision rests on an inferred number.

Twenty-two rules (R-01 to R-22) are checked against this site on the Policy compliance page, each linked to the exact official section. Prices, ratings and reviews are withheld; no Amazon trademark is in the domain; no paid search, no sub-tags, no incentives, no price tracking.
requirements.blocker: Open legal-review items remain: R-11 (the license limits on collecting listing content) and R-12 (AI and model restrictions). See the Flagged for review page.

requirements.delivered: The Operating Agreement Section 5 sentence is on every page and directly beside every affiliate link. The FTC placement test (hard to miss, placed with the endorsement, simple language) and the Associates help page requirement that the link-level disclosure be clear and conspicuous and near the link are both implemented.

requirements.requirement: Live site with a clean landing page and subpages organized by category.
requirements.delivered: Thirteen pages: a dashboard landing page, three category pages (dual-basket air fryers, single-basket air fryers, air-fry toaster ovens), and the executive summary, all-products, analysis, verification, policy, requirements, analytics, flagged and sources pages. Deployed by GitHub Pages from main.

requirements.requirement: Clean, user friendly, simple, easy to use UI, like a simple dashboard.
requirements.delivered: One fixed sidebar navigates every page; the landing page uses KPI tiles and cards; wide tables scroll inside their own container and the two long tables have a live filter box.

requirements.requirement: Contain all entries and findings in a simple, easy to read table format.
requirements.delivered: Products, verification log, policy rules, analysis findings, requirements and sources are all rendered as tables. Every row states its value, status and source.

Nine findings (A-01 to A-09) on the Analysis and findings page, each with its basis, a confidence level and its official source links. A-08 names the price-tracking rule that blocks pricing analysis; A-09 records how the source-link rule is enforced.

requirements.requirement: Every table row must have a source link to an official site.
requirements.delivered: Enforced, not asserted: scripts/verify.py parses every table body row on every page and fails if a row has no link to an official host (amazon.com, link.amazon, affiliate-program.amazon.com, ftc.gov, github.com, api.github.com).

requirements.requirement: If a value cannot be confirmed from an official source, leave it blank and flag it as unverified.
requirements.delivered: Prices, ratings, review counts, commission rates, trend and conversion are blank on the site and appear as flags F-01, F-02 and F-15 on the Flagged for review page with their sources and the action needed.

requirements.requirement: Create an executive summary outlining important details.
requirements.delivered: Executive summary page: headline, eight findings, the four decisions that need the user, and the six capabilities that are deliberately not built.

requirements.requirement: Publish the site on GitHub Pages.
requirements.delivered: Published at https://kanlerxz87-cyber.github.io/Zone4/. The Pages source is main / (legacy build); the root index.html redirects to docs/index.html and a root .nojekyll is present, both of which verify.py checks.

requirements.requirement: Build marketing for the three supplied products.
requirements.delivered: Each of the three supplied links is resolved to its Amazon listing, verified, and published on a category page with its disclosure and its competitor context.
requirements.blocker: No marketing copy, comparison or buying guide is published for them, because that is gated by REQ-09 to REQ-13. This page is the honest inventory of what is and is not in place.
